gage — a git-backed, age-encrypted secret & notes manager

Usage:
  gage [command]

Vault lifecycle:
  init                      Create a new vault
  clone                     Clone an existing vault from a remote
  vault list                List registered vaults
  vault info                Show a vault's type, method, recipient count, and (for git) remote/status
  vault remove              Forget a vault locally, leaving its files untouched
  vault set-default         Change which vault is used when none is given

Identity:
  identity add              Register this device's identity and print its public key
  identity enroll           Register this device's identity and publish a request to join
  identity list             List the keys this machine holds for a vault

Recipients:
  recipient add             Authorize a public key and re-encrypt the vault to include it
  recipient remove          Revoke a recipient and re-encrypt the vault without its key
  recipient list            List the keys this vault is encrypted to
  recipient verify          Check .age-recipients and config.toml still agree
  recovery enroll           Use a recovery key to enroll a fresh identity for this device
  recovery rotate           Replace this vault's recovery key, or add one if it has none
  recovery verify           Check a stored recovery key is still one of this vault's recipients
  recipient pending         List enrollment requests waiting to be approved
  recipient approve         Admit an enrolling device and re-encrypt the vault to include it
  recipient deny            Remove an enrollment request without granting anything

Entry CRUD:
  insert                    Create a new entry
  show                      Print an entry's value
  cat                       Print an entry's full decrypted contents
  edit                      Edit an entry's full YAML in $EDITOR
  rename                    Change an entry's title
  generate                  Create a new entry with a randomly generated value
  rm                        Delete an entry
  mv                        Move an entry to another vault — the sharing mechanism
  cp                        Copy an entry into another vault, keeping the original
  ls                        List entries with their ids, dates, and last writer
  search, grep              Find entries by title, description, or body text
  reindex                   Force a session's cached metadata index to rebuild

Sync:
  sync                      Pull, merge what can be merged, then push
  pull                      Fast-forward this vault from its remote
  push                      Publish this vault's commits to its remote
  log                       Show an entry's commit history — timestamps only, nothing decrypted
  history                   Decrypt every past revision of one entry (surfaces old secret values)

Git-specific:
  git set-remote            Set or change a vault's git remote (origin)
  auth login                Store a token for a git host
  auth status               Show which git hosts have a token
  auth logout               Forget a git host's token

Use "gage help <command>" (or "gage <command> --help") for more information about a command.
